title: Enhanced Action Against Drivers of Vehicles with Illegally Modified Exhaust Systems
what_it_is: Enhanced Action Against Drivers of Vehicles with Illegally Modified Exhaust Systems

sections.label: Illegal vehicle modification enforcement
sections.summary: LTA enforces against illegal modifications, with fines up to $5,000 or three months' jail, and up to $10,000 or six months for repeat offenders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: LTA conducts regular enforcement operations to deter and detect illegal modifications.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Traffic Police (TP) will refer such cases it comes across to LTA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Individuals or workshops that make illegal modifications and individuals who drive illegally modified vehicles may be fined up to $5,000 or imprisoned up to three months, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Repeat offenders may be fined up to $10,000 or imprisoned up to six months, or both.

sections.label: Feedback and joint operations
sections.summary: The speaker says they look at specific issues and feedback received, and carry out joint operations when they receive such information.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Indeed, we not only look at specific issues but we also look at the feedback that we receive.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We also carry out joint operations when we receive such information.

sections.label: NEA stricter approach guidelines
sections.summary: The speaker says guidelines exist and NEA has taken a more stringent approach, especially from this year, and cases will be addressed with community and agencies.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Indeed, there are guidelines and, in fact, if you look at it, over the years, especially starting from this year, the National Environment Agency (NEA) has taken on a more stringent approach.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, you can see that things are more stringent and tighter today.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: This is something that we have been doing.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: There may be cases here and there, but we will look at them and address the issues together with the community and the agencies.
